name: hook
description: An empty project for hook gates. The gate runs the plugin's real hook entry point through hooks/hooks.json, with the fixture's hook-input.json on stdin and CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR set to the work directory, and maps the answer to an exit code: 0 clean, 1 a violation (a PreToolUse ask or deny decision, or a PostToolUse or Stop exit 2), 2 a run that judged nothing.
